Metadata.CommitMsg:
feat(security): implement Delivery 3 - Security Hardening (DevSecOps)

- Generate CycloneDX SBOM with Trivy (security/sbom.json)
- Fix SQL injection (CWE-89) in model/auth.js and model/products.js
  using parameterized queries
- Patch minimatch ReDoS vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-26996, CVE-2026-27903,
  CVE-2026-27904) via npm audit fix
- Add Husky pre-commit hook for secret detection in staged files
- Add GitHub Actions security-scan workflow (Trivy + SBOM in CI)
- Update tests to validate parameterized query patterns
- Add security npm scripts (security:sbom, security:scan)
- All 55 tests passing, 98.38% coverage maintained
